title: Bake's own system prompt for bake-rs against Pi's
note: Both arms are bake-rs -p from clean release builds: the base at the PR base (8788481281, Pi's prompt) and the candidate at 626e3249b0, which builds Bake's own prompt (D33) and runs a response's bash, edit, and write calls in order. Both keep Pi's tools, the danger-full-access preset, and agent retry off. gemini-3.8-flash-medium was not configured on the gateway on 2026-10-13, so the Gemini rows run gemini-3.8-flash-high at medium effort, as in the native-arm record. The candidate's first request is about 690 bytes smaller. Requests fall 16.5% on both Claude models, 12.5% on deepseek-flash, 54.5% on Gemini, and 4.9% on gpt-6.1-sol; deepseek-v4-pro is unchanged (94 -> 94) and still splits edits from their checks. Total tokens fall on every model (5 to 59%). Gemini ran git in the fixture workspace, which is not a repository, in 19 of 24 base samples and 3 candidate samples, after the prompt began stating 'Git repository: no'; its tool errors fall 20 -> 1. claude-sonnet-5-5 tool errors 0 -> 1: in one unprompted_edit sample Sonnet ran the failing test to reproduce the bug before fixing it, and Pi's bash reports a non-zero exit as a tool error; accepted. gpt-6.1-sol: 12/21 pairs. Its 10 failures (7 base, 3 candidate) are all the whitespace runaway after an edit call's arguments that reaches the wall-clock limit, because bake-ai has no runaway guard (the follow-up the native-arm record names).

settings.effort: medium where the model offers it; DeepSeek runs at high, its default, having no medium

regressionRule: all tasks, per model: total tokens with the 95% interval above zero; requests up more than 10% with the 95% interval above zero; failures +2 or more; any tool-error increase
